body:
Founder: 'implement plus and optional next.' match-plus/match-optional added to stdlib/regex/pcre.prn, verified byte-identical to real grep (a+b, colou?r) across the 949-file monorepo corpus. Critical finding along the way: match-node's Star dispatch passed inner BY VALUE where match_star's C signature expects PatternNode* -- silently broken all session, undetected by gcc because emit.c's forward declarations are empty-parens/K&R-style (no call-site arg type-checking). Confirmed live segfault (./turbogrep 'a*b' file -> exit 139) on what was already the account's installed system grep. Fixed with &inner at the Star/Plus/Optional dispatch call sites. node-supported? also missing explicit Plus/Optional cases, added. Commit 9a622f5.

⚓ ☃
title: Plus/Optional implemented; critical Star segfault found+fixed
